templates_page.title: Pick a design. We launch it for you.
templates_page.subtitle: Browse ready-made website designs for your type of business. Choose one, message us, and we launch it with your branding and content within days.
templates_page.step1_d: Open the live demos and choose the design that fits your business.
templates_page.step2_d: Message us on WhatsApp — we confirm pages, features, and your domain in one short call.
templates_page.step3_d: We rebrand, fill in your content, and launch on your domain. You start getting customers.
templates_page.how_title: How payment works — personal, not a checkout
templates_page.how_1_d: Every order starts with a conversation, so you only pay for what your business actually needs.
templates_page.how_2_d: Bank transfer (IBAN), Wise, or a secure card payment link we send you — 50% deposit to start, 50% at launch.

templates_page.cta_desc: We add new templates from real client projects all the time — tell us what you do and we'll show you the closest match.
